extractions.quote: She had a recent history of hemeralopia due to a proved retinitis pigmentosa. HLA typing was as follows: Aw 19, A3, B44, Bw 41. Creatine phospho kinase (CPK) was increased to 408 UIA. Ig G level in serum was 23%. SSEPs showed decreased amplitudes with normal latencies for medullary responses. An electroencephalogram was normal. A muscle biopsy was normal.
